card_title: Artist Notes: Flexible-Architecture Hair Styling Clay
summary: Matte texture, absolute control. A high-hold styling clay that provides pliable structure without crunch or shine.
description: Sculptural hair engineering. This bentonite-based clay absorbs excess moisture and oils, providing a gritty, textured finish that thickens the hair profile while allowing for restyling throughout the day.
technical_overview: Offered at $26.0 for 60g, this KoColor HAIR_STYLING is expertly formulated with Bentonite Clay, Beeswax, and Castor Oil. It delivers a high-fidelity Slate Clay color profile (`#778899`) and leverages moisture-absorbing matte technology.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Emulsify a dime-sized amount completely between palms until warm, then work through dry hair from root to tip.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Always apply to dry hair; applying to damp hair will dilute the clay and result in an unwanted shiny, heavy finish.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Bentonite clay physically swells around the individual hair shafts, instantly expanding the visual density of the hair.
